newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stock markets closed for golden jubilee.
newsitem.headline: Indian stock markets closed for golden jubilee.

text.p: Indian stock markets are closed to mark the country's 50th anniversary of independence on Friday, brokers said.

The markets are expected to consolidate as foreign institutional investors draw in their horns in preparation for two large issues of international equity by state-run Gas Authority of India Ltd.,, and the Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd..
These issues of Global Depostiary Receipts are scheduled sometime in October or November, brokers said.
The Bombay Stock Exchange's top-30 share index finished 49.25 points, or 1.13 percent lower at 4,320.97.
